Cluster Setup Validation
2 | CLUSTER SETUP VALIDATION
Introduction
The preference-controlled settings for cluster and remote computing provide the 
possibility to create models and applications that can be run with different configurations 
without changing anything in the model or application itself. This functionality makes it 
easier to distribute the model or application and to change the run environment without 
the need for a different version of the model or application for each different setup.
This application provides an easy way for administrators of COMSOL Server™ and users 
of COMSOL Multiphysics
® to test that cluster and remote settings are set up to correctly 
submit jobs to the cluster. At the same time, it creates a testable environment for 
modifications to the current setup or for testing a new set of settings for connecting to a 
cluster.
User Interface
The following image shows the application’s user interface and explains the main 
components of the Cluster Setup Validation application.
3 | CLUSTER SETUP VALIDATION
Update Geometry, Create 
Mesh and Results provide 
visual information about 
the models. The Compute 
button starts the 
computation. The Help 
button opens this 
documentation.
Clear all the current 
settings for the app.
Provides information about the 
state of the application, test 
results from the last computation, 
and if the settings have been 
changed since the last test.
When the Override settings 
checkbox is selected, the settings in 
the two tabs are used for the 
cluster job. The sections are made 
to mimic the information that is 
relevant for cluster jobs when 
running with preference-controlled 
settings. The Cluster Computing 
tab represents the cluster 
computing part in the preferences, 
and the Remote Computing tab 
represents the run remote section.
Here it is possible to change the 
type of model used as well as the 
number of nodes used for the 
cluster job. Note that the 
expected speedup from running 
on multiple nodes is negligible, 
and it could even take longer to 
run on multiple nodes due to the 
simple models used for testing.
The cluster log presents 
data from the internal 
COMSOL log and 
provides information 
about how the cluster job 
is progressing.
The message log provides 
information about the 
expected computation 
time when a test has been 
started and when a test has 
finished.
Reset to the default 
settings for the app.
Export the current 
settings to a file.
Import a set of 
settings from a file.
4 | CLUSTER SETUP VALIDATION
Prerequisites and Workflow
REQUIREMENTS
The following requirements have to be fulfilled when running the Cluster Setup Validation 
app:
• For COMSOL Multiphysics: A Floating Network License (FNL) and COMSOL 
Cluster Components must be installed.
 For COMSOL Server: COMSOL Cluster Components must be installed.
In addition, before you run the Cluster Setup Validation app, make sure the security 
settings are modified in the corresponding way:
Set the File system access list under Security to All files.
WORKFLOW
The workflow when using this application is as follows:
1 Click Compute in the Home ribbon to test the settings.
2 If there are any errors, select the Override settings checkbox, and then modify the 
settings and run more test until you have a working cluster configuration.
3 Export the settings by clicking Export in the ribbon toolbar to save the settings to a local 
file.
4 Open the Preferences dialog box and import the local file using the Import button.
5 Save the preferences in COMSOL Server and COMSOL Multiphysics, and then restart 
the application.
Note: When running COMSOL Server, you must have Administrator privileges to 
change the preferences.
Using the Cluster Setup Validation App
THE EXTERNAL QUEUE
To set up a connection, it is a lot easier if the queue can be monitored at the same time as 
running the test. Otherwise, it could be hard to determine what the cause of potential 
errors that could occur is.
5 | CLUSTER SETUP VALIDATION
READING THE CLUSTER LOG FOR ERRORS
The cluster log is the internal log presented by COMSOL.
The cluster log will provide messages from the study on how the cluster job is progressing. 
This is helpful when debugging errors in the cluster configuration.
When starting the test, COMSOL will write a few lines of local data from the local process. 
The local data is displayed below.
If there are only these few lines after an extended amount of time, then it is possible that 
the connection between the local process and the remote process is not correctly 
configured.
If the cluster job has been correctly started and there is communication between the 
cluster job and the local application, a message should be displayed that COMSOL is 
starting in batch mode, followed by Opening file: ****. where **** is the path to the 
stored file.
From that point in time, the connection should be established, and the job continues to 
run as intended. When the job is finished, it will be printed in the cluster log. When the 
remote process is done with the test, the data needs to be transferred back to the local 
process.

6 | CLUSTER SETUP VALIDATION
Common Errors
The following errors can occur when running the Cluster Validation app. Here you find 
some information about possible reasons for those errors and what you can do to avoid 
them.
THE USER INTERFACE IS FROZEN AND NOTHING IS HAPPENING AFTER 
COMPUTE
This is a common error if the connection between the two processes (the local and the 
remote) is not established. Check the external queues and see if the job has been canceled, 
finished, or if it is waiting for resources.
If the job is still waiting for resources and there are node resources available for the cluster, 
close the job manually. In the application, click the Detach Job button in the bottom-right 
corner and the user interface will become active again.
Note: Detach job is used to not follow the external process anymore. For this 
application, there is no intention to attach to the job again. Detaching the external 
process will leave the remote process running on the cluster, and therefore it is important 
to close the cluster job manually.
FILE SYSTEM ACCESS IS NOT SET TO “ALL FILES”
Set the Security preference File system access to All files and restart the application.
THE SYSTEM CANNOT FIND THE SPECIFIED PATH
Check the batch directory and server directory paths; do these path really exist?
PROCESS STATUS INDICATES THAT THE PROCESS FAILED
You get an error status for the process: Error ****. Read the cluster log for a more in-depth 
error explanation. There are several potential reasons for such a process failure.
NO ERROR, AND THE USER INTERFACE FREEZES
This situation can occur due to multiple things that might have happened, but first check 
the external queue. Here you can see if the job was actually placed in the queue. If the job 
is waiting for resources, then everything is as intended. Wait for the resources to be freed 
up, and the job should run after that. 
7 | CLUSTER SETUP VALIDATION
If the job never reached the queue but failed or finished without notifying the application 
then there are a few things that could have gone wrong. First check if External COMSOL 
batch directory actually contains the files that you want to read from. If the Stationary/
Sweep file can be located in the external COMSOL batch directory (or a subfolder for the 
COMSOL Server case) then the data has been transferred correctly. If the files are not 
there is a problem how the file was transferred between the local and remote processes. If 
the files are there it could be that the job was never submitted correctly and there is a silent 
crash in the submitting command.
Example
This example is only using local connections, so it is universally viable. Before the test start, 
it is assumed that the Cluster Computing and Remote Computing preferences are set to 
their default values.
Under Cluster Computing preferences:
 Set Scheduler type to Not distributed.
 Set Batch directory to ./not/a/valid/path.
The provided preferences are the starting preferences. This set of preferences is made to 
fail. For the preferences to have any effect on the application, the preferences need to be 
saved before the application is launched.
Start the Cluster Setup Validation application and click the Compute button. An error is 
displayed: “The system cannot find the path specified.”
Select the Override settings checkbox, and then modify the incorrect field:
Set Batch directory to temp:///.
Click the Compute button again. The test should now pass, and the solved model should 
appear in the Graphics window.
Transfer the working configuration to the preferences. This can be done by exporting the 
preferences from the application and importing them into COMSOL Server or COMSOL 
Multiphysics in the Preferences window or Preferences dialog box.
Restart the Cluster Setup Validation application and click the Compute button. The setup 
should now be correct, and no error occurs during the new test run.
8 | CLUSTER SETUP VALIDATION

集 群 设 置 验 证
2 |  集 群 设 置 验 证
简介
我们可以通过集群和远程计算的首选项控制设置来创建可以在不同的配置下运行的模
型和 App，而无需更改模型或 App 本身。此功能使得分发模型或 App 以及更改运行环
境变得更加容易，无需针对每个不同的设置使用不同版本的模型或 App。
本 App 为 COMSOL Server™ 管理员和 COMSOL Multiphysics® 用户提供了一种简便的
方法，用于测试是否已设定集群和远程设置，以便正确地将作业提交到集群。同时，
它还创建了一个可测试的环境，用于修改当前设置或测试连接到集群的新设置。
3 |  集 群 设 置 验 证
用户界面
下图显示了 App 的用户界面，并解释了 “集群设置验证” App 的主要组件。
4 |  集 群 设 置 验 证
“更新几何” 、 “创建网
格”和 “结果”提供有
关模型的可视化信息。
“计算”按钮可启动计
算。 “帮助”按钮可打开
本文档。
清除 App 的所有当前
设置。
提供有关 App 状态、上次计算
的测试结果以及自上次测试以
来设置是否已更改的信息。
选中 “替代”设置复选框后，
两个选项卡中的设置将用于集群
作业。这些栏旨在模拟使用首选
项控制设置运行时与集群作业相
关的信息。 “集群计算”选项卡
表示首选项中的集群计算栏，
“远程计算”选项卡表示远程运
行栏。
在这里可以更改所使用的模型
类型以及用于集群作业的节点
数。请注意，在多个节点上运
行的预期加速可以忽略不计，
由于测试采用的模型很简单，
在多个节点上运行甚至可能需
要更长的时间。
集群日志显示来自内部 
COMSOL 日志的数据，
并提供有关集群作业进
展情况的信息。
消息日志提供有关测试
开始和测试完成时的预
估所需计算时间的信息。

设置。

到文件。
从文件导入一组
设置。
5 |  集 群 设 置 验 证
先决条件和工作流程
要 求
运行 “集群设置验证” App 时必须满足以下要求：
• COMSOL Multiphysics：必须安装网络浮动许可证 (FNL) 和 COMSOL 集群组件。
• COMSOL Server：必须安装 COMSOL 集群组件。
此外，在运行 “集群设置验证” App 之前，请确保以相应的方式修改安全性设置：
将安全性下的文件系统访问列表设置为所有文件。
工 作 流 程
使用本 App 的工作流程如下：
1 单击主屏幕功能区中的计算来测试设置。
2 如果出现任何错误，选中替代设置复选框，然后修改设置并运行更多测试，直到获
得可正常运行的集群配置。
3 导出设置，方法是单击功能区工具栏中的导出，将设置保存到本地文件。
4 打开首选项对话框，使用导入按钮导入本地文件。
5 保存 COMSOL Server 和 COMSOL Multiphysics 中的首选项，然后重新启动 App。
注：运行 COMSOL Server 时，您必须拥有管理员权限才能更改首选项。
6 |  集 群 设 置 验 证
使用 “集群设置验证” App
外 部 队 列
如果可以在运行测试的同时监视队列，建立连接就会容易得多。否则，可能很难确定
可能发生的潜在错误的原因。
阅 读 集 群 日 志 以 查 找 错 误
集群日志是 COMSOL 提供的内部日志。
集群日志将提供有关集群作业进展情况的研究消息，这在调试集群配置中的错误时非
常有用。
开始测试时， COMSOL 将从本地进程写入若干行本地数据，如下所示。
如果经过较长时间后只有这几行，可能是本地进程与远程进程之间的连接配置不正确。
如果集群作业已正确启动，且集群作业与本地 App 之间存在通信，软件应显示一条消
息，表明 COMSOL 在批处理模式下启动，后面显示正在打开文件：****。其中，**** 
是存储文件的路径。
从此时起，连接应已建立，作业将继续按预期运行。作业完成后，将打印在集群日志
中。远程进程完成测试后，需要将数据传输回本地进程。

7 |  集 群 设 置 验 证
常见错误
运行 “集群验证” App 时可能会出现以下错误，您可以从中了解这些错误的可能原因
以及避免错误的方法。
用 户 界 面 冻 结 ， 计 算 后 没 有 任 何 反 应
如果 （本地和远程）两个进程之间未建立连接，这是一个常见错误。检查外部队列，
查看作业是否已取消、完成或是否正在等待资源。
如果作业仍在等待资源，且集群有可用的节点资源，请手动关闭作业。在 App 中，单
击右下角的脱离作业按钮，用户界面将再次变为活动状态。
注：“脱离作业”意味着不再遵循外部进程。对于本 App，并不打算再次附加到作业。
脱离外部进程将使远程进程在集群上运行，因此务必手动关闭集群作业。
“ 文 件 系 统 访 问 ” 未 设 置 为 “ 所 有 文 件 ”
将安全性首选项文件系统访问设置为所有文件，然后重新启动 App。
系 统 找 不 到 指 定 的 路 径
检查批处理目录和服务器目录路径；这些路径是否真的存在？
进 程 状 态 表 明 进 程 失 败
您将收到该进程的错误状态：错误 ****。阅读集群日志，了解更深入的错误解释。进
程失败可能有多种原因。
没 有 错 误 ， 用 户 界 面 冻 结
出现这种情况可能有多种原因，但首先要检查外部队列，您可以从中查看作业是否确
实被放入队列。如果作业正在等待资源，那么一切都会按预期进行。等待资源被释放
后，作业应该会运行。
如果作业从未进入队列，而是失败或在未通知 App 的情况下完成，则可能存在一些问
题。首先检查外部 COMSOL 批处理目录是否确实包含您要阅读的文件。如果 “稳态 /
扫描”文件可以位于外部 COMSOL 批处理目录 （或 COMSOL Server 案例的子文件
夹）中，则数据已正确传输。如果文件不存在，说明文件在本地进程与远程进程之间
的传输方式存在问题。如果文件存在，可能是作业从未正确提交，提交命令中出现静
默崩溃。
8 |  集 群 设 置 验 证
示例
本示例仅使用本地连接，因此普遍可行。在测试开始之前，假设 “集群计算”和 “远
程计算”首选项设置为其默认值。
在 “集群计算”首选项下：
• 将调度器类型设置为未分配。
• 将批处理目录设置为 ./not/a/valid/path。
提供的首选项是起始首选项，这组首选项会失败。要使首选项对 App 产生影响，需要
在启动 App 之前保存首选项。
启动 “集群设置验证” App 并单击计算按钮。显示错误： “系统找不到指定的路径。 ”
选中替代设置复选框，然后修改不正确的字段：
将批处理目录设置为 temp:///。
再次单击计算按钮。现在测试应该已通过，已求解的模型应该显示在图形窗口中。
将工作配置转移到首选项，方法是从 App 中导出首选项，并在首选项窗口或首选项对话
框中将其导入到 COMSOL Server 或 COMSOL Multiphysics。
重新启动 “集群设置验证” App 并单击计算按钮。现在设置应该是正确的，并且在新
的测试运行期间不会出现错误。
